description: AzAHP practitioner data form page 1 (tagged, no title): a logo and title box, an intro sentence, and eight numbered directions with lettered (a, b, c) and roman (i, ii) sub-steps. No form fields on this page.

not_heading: Directions for completing the AzAHP Practitioner Data Form (AzAHP). Any questions regarding this form, please check with your Health Plan representative.

items: The information is necessary to add into the Provider Directory and payment system for claims processing. This form is also used for providers that may not require credentialing due to their provide type. If you do not have a Professional license (MD, DO, NP, etc), please disregard the CAQH Registration requirements.
CAQH Registration is required (http:/www.caqh.org—for assistance please contact the CAQH HELP DESK at 1-888-599-1771)
